blocks.title: Velocity selector
blocks.text: Velocity selector aisa aala hai jo charged zarre ki velocity maloom karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Is mein chalte zarre par electric aur magnetic forces is tarah lagai jati hain ke woh sirf ek velocity ke liye ek doosre ko balance karein, aur zarra mustaqil velocity se chalta rahe.

Musbat charge +q wala zarra lein jo yaksan magnetic field B mein us ke amudi velocity v se dakhil hota hai. Magnetic force zarre par oopar ki taraf lagti hai (Fig. 10.11). Is magnetic force ko balance karne ke liye zarre par neeche ki taraf electric force lagni chahiye.

blocks.alt: Magnetic field kaghaz ke andar, crosses se dikhaya. Musbat charge velocity v se daen chalta hai aur us par force F = q v B kaghaz mein oopar ki taraf. Dabba kehta hai F = q (v x B), v aur B dono se seedhe zaviye par, is liye harkat ki simt badalti hai raftar nahi.
blocks.caption: Kaghaz ke andar field mein chalte musbat charge par magnetic force (Figure 10.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Velocity selector magnetic field B ke andar rakhi ek nalkidar (cylindrical) tube par mushtamil hai. Tube ke andar parallel plate capacitor hai jo yaksan electric field E banata hai, jo magnetic field B ke amudi hai (Fig. 10.12). Jab charged zarra tube ke baen sire se dakhil hota hai to magnetic force oopar aur electric force musbat charged zarre par E ki simt mein neeche lagti hai. Agar electric aur magnetic fields ki taqat munasib tor par tay ki jaye to yeh forces ek doosre ko khatam kar deti hain. Zarre par koi khalis force na hone se us ki velocity v Newton ke pehle qanoon ke mutabiq mustaqil rehti hai; zarra mustaqil velocity se seedhi lakeer mein chal kar tube ke daen sire se nikalta hai. v se mukhtalif velocity wale zarre mur jate hain aur daen sire se nahi nikalte.

blocks.alt: Musbat charge oopar musbat aur neeche manfi plate ke darmiyan, kaghaz ke andar wale magnetic field mein dakhil hota hai. Electric force qE use neeche aur magnetic force qvB oopar dhakelti hai. Jab qE = qvB, yaani v = E / B, charge seedha guzar jata hai.
blocks.caption: Velocity selector: magnetic field mein capacitor plates ke darmiyan charge (Figure 10.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Chuni gayi velocity ki miqdar seedhe nikalti hai. Chunke v, B aur E dono ke amudi hai, magnetic force (oopar) Bqv aur electric force (neeche) qE hai. Zarre ke na murne ke liye Bqv = qE, ya v = E/B ... (10.15).

blocks.title: Example 10.4
blocks.text: 1000 m s^-1 se 2000 m s^-1 tak speed wale alpha particles aise velocity selector mein dakhil hote hain jahan electric intensity 300 V m^-1 aur magnetic induction 0.20 T hai. Kaun se particles field se be-mude (undeviated) guzrenge? Hal: E = 300 V m^-1 = 300 N C^-1, B = 0.20 T. Sirf woh particles guzrenge jin par electric force qE magnetic force Bqv ko balance kare (Fig. 10.12): qE = Bqv, to v = E/B = 300 N C^-1/0.20 N A^-1 m^-1 = 1500 m s^-1. 1500 m s^-1 speed wale alpha particles be-mude guzrenge.

blocks.title: Example 10.5
blocks.text: Ek charged zarra velocity selector se mustaqil velocity par seedhi lakeer mein guzarta hai. Selector ki electric field 4.8 x 10^3 N C^-1 aur magnetic field 0.2 T hai. Electric field band karne par zarra 3.0 cm radius ke gol raste par chalta hai. Zarre ki charge to mass ratio nikalein. Hal: chunke zarra E aur B dono ke amudi chalta hai, qE = Bqv aur v = E/B. Electric field band hone par magnetic force centripetal force deti hai: Bqv = mv^2/r, to q/m = v/(Br). v = E/B rakhne par q/m = E/(B^2 r) = 4.8 x 10^3 N C^-1/((0.2 T)^2 x 3 x 10^-2 m) = 4 x 10^6 C kg^-1.
Magnetic field mein chalte charged zarre par force lagti hai. Woh kis simt mein chale ke us par koi force na lage? Field lines ke saath, kyunke tab theta = 0 aur qvB sin theta = 0 (Point to ponder).

blocks.prompt: Velocity selector kya hai? Is ka kaam wazeh kijiye (comprehensive question 10.5). Ek zarra 4.96 x 10^4 m s^-1 par B = 0.114 T wale selector se be-mude guzarta hai; kitni electric field chahiye (numerical 10.11, print mein 7.11)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh aisa ilaqa hai jahan yaksan electric field aur yaksan magnetic field ek doosre aur beam ke amudi lagti hain; chalte charge par electric force qE aur magnetic force Bqv ulat hain, aur sirf v = E/B par khatam hoti hain, to sirf us speed ke zarre seedhe guzarte hain jabke tez ya dheemay mur jate hain. E = vB = 4.96 x 10^4 x 0.114 = 5.65 x 10^3 N C^-1.

items: Velocity selector: amudi E (capacitor plates) aur B; +q par magnetic force Bqv oopar aur electric force qE neeche; sirf v = E/B (10.15) par balance; woh zarra seedha jata hai (Newton ka pehla qanoon), baqi mur jate hain.
Example 10.4: 1500 m s^-1 guzarta hai. Example 10.5: q/m = E/(B^2 r) = 4 x 10^6 C kg^-1.
